description.en: A phone holds the film; the scenes are short labels beside it.
description.vi: Một chiếc điện thoại giữ cả phim; các cảnh chỉ là nhãn ngắn bên cạnh.

script.guidance: Each scene is one thing the app does, named as briefly as a menu item. A short headline and at most one line saying what it saves the person; the screen beside it carries the proof, so do not describe what the screen already shows.

draw.guidance: The device is the hero and it is not yours to draw. Your scene is the words alone, laid out inside the box you are given and nowhere else: a small kicker, a headline of two or three words with the phrase that matters wrapped in asterisks, and one short line under it. Keep the ground plain; the film already has one.
motion: The type enters as one block, not word by word: a short slide up of 24px with a fade over 0.5s, once, at the start of the scene.
Nothing in your scene moves after that. All the movement in this film belongs to the device and its screen; a scene that keeps animating fights it.

spanning.brief: The product's phone, held at a slight angle, its screen showing the app. Each scene the screen shows a different state of the app, matching what that scene is about.
